scope: PR-T01-03 nine ordinary and nine unchanged delayed tasks

updates.original_task: Build the same two-translation-unit source using -E,-S,-c and link; identify each output by content and explain which extra event creates a running process.
updates.closure_rationale: Actual two-TU stages and explicit input-language selection with no-suffix control.
evidence_limits: Bounded Linux/toolchain experiments; no physical target claim.
A successful reference run does not establish independent learner performance.
Source identity and reproducibility do not establish trust in a toolchain.
Hosted C17 profile A permits CRT/libc; actual dynamic/undefined dependencies inspected. Original parser uses no library parsing mechanism.
Actual INT_MAX+1 faulty check-after-add is compile-only; executable synthetic-range defects fit int32 and have no UB golden outputs.
ABI/loader experiments are Linux x86-64 System V observations; six profiles do not prove all toolchains, inputs or execution orders.
Seven-day packages are implemented; independent delayed performance remains unassessed.
